name: Common-sense metrics, sourced stages
principle: Every metric is a plain check anyone would accept, and its stages come from public evaluations whose sources are named and compared with each other.
state_description: Each metric says in everyday words what it checks, each public stage cites its source, and a stage is trusted only when independent public results agree with it.
hints_of_measurement: The share of metric stages with a named public source, and the share confirmed by a second independent source.

name: Best in each circumstance, with variants
principle: Each user gets the part that is best under their own limits, such as cost, speed, language or input size.
state_description: A user states a limit such as cost or speed and gets the part measured best under it, with the winning variant named.
hints_of_measurement: The share of seats with a recorded winner per circumstance, and variants run on the same cases as their base.

name: Guards earn their place
principle: A guard is kept only when it catches something the model or harness would miss.
state_description: Every guard has a recorded gain over the native checks, and a guard with no gain is removed.
hints_of_measurement: Catches per case with the guard minus without it, beside its cost and delay.

name: Agent work at the lowest cost that does it well
principle: Work handed to an agent finishes at the lowest cost and time that keeps the same quality, with context that is enough and no more.
state_description: On a subscription the harness finishes the same work with fewer tokens and less time than the alternatives, and the context it gets is the smallest that is enough.
hints_of_measurement: A balanced score of pass rate, cost and time, ranked across harness, context, sub-agent and recursion settings.

name: Proportionate, current cards
principle: A folder's cards cover what is in it, about one card per thing people ask about, and change when the files change.
state_description: Asking about any part of a folder finds a card that names the right files, the store stays about the size of the folder's topics, and no card describes code that is gone.
hints_of_measurement: The file a task needs is among the first files of the cards a fixed selector picks; cards per folder stay level across rebuilds; an edited file's cards are reported stale.

name: A system offers its own context
principle: The AI can draw on everything a system knows, in any system, without code written for that system.
state_description: The AI answers from what the system knows without code written for each system.
hints_of_measurement: A new source is declared with no change to the hub's parts.
